div.div:
ID model
songId = SHA-1 of file path, 12 chars (which song; stable, content-addressed)
entryId = fresh id per queue slot (which queue line; lets a song be queued twice)
State: queue is in-memory (lost on restart). No cookies or sessions.
Auth on /dj, queue, events via DJ_USER / DJ_PASS. Audience side open.
